info.name: HotUKDeals Mosaic - Tiles Layout
info.description:
Turns the HotUKDeals deal list into a compact grid of tiles.

- More deals on screen: tiles fill the full width, and closing the sidebar boxes gives you even more columns.
- Only what matters: votes, time, image, title, price, merchant, comments and the deal button. No descriptions, share or bookmark clutter.
- Tidy tiles: equal heights, two-line titles, images scaled to fit.
- Voucher codes in one pill: code and copy button on a single line.
- Small touches: a pin badge for pinned deals, and a readable expiry countdown.
- Infinite scroll still works, and the sidebar ads are hidden.
